channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building): Mission Hall's ribbon-cutting was shown as October 2014 on the strength of a UCSF news story that could not be read. It is now dated 2014 only, like its completion, and the month is listed as unconfirmed.

item.title: Correction · Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building): No readable source gives a story count (OpenStreetMap tags six levels) or names the Office of the Chancellor as an occupant, so 'seven-story' and the Chancellor were removed. Size now shows WRNS's 266,000 sq ft and Rudolph and Sletten's 264,000; the roughly 1,500 occupants come from Rudolph and Sletten's page and the global health programs from UCSF's history page. Design-builder and landscape architect are now cited to their own project pages. The address note no longer says the architect's page gives 550 16th St (it gives no address), and the Wikimedia photo credit no longer names an author or a flight the file page does not state. The September 2014 occupancy and October 2014 ribbon-cutting rest on a UCSF page that could not be read and were left in place; their timeline entries now link that page.
